about.title: Privacy & help
about.privacyBody: No account, no login, no Akshar servers. OCR runs entirely on your phone. Screenshots are held in memory only while they are read, then discarded. History, if on, stays on this phone. The only exception is “Speak with translation”: after you opt in, the extracted text (never the screenshot) is sent to the Google Gemini API with your own API key.
about.permOverlayWhy: Draws the floating capture button above other apps.
about.permCaptureWhy: Lets the app take one screenshot each time you tap the button. Android asks every time you turn the button on; you can share the entire screen or just one app.
about.permServiceWhy: Android requires it while screen sharing is active; it shows the ongoing notification with a Stop action.
about.permNotificationsWhy: Shows that ongoing notification on Android 13 and later.
about.tipBlank: Nothing is detected in an app: it may block screen capture (banking, DRM video, incognito tabs). This is enforced by Android.
about.tipStopped: The button disappeared: screen sharing ended (from the status bar, lock screen, or another app). Turn it on again from the home screen.
about.tipAccuracy: Poor results: pick the OCR language that matches the screen, zoom in on small text, and avoid blurred or animated content.
about.tipSingleApp: Only one app is readable: you chose “Share one app”. Turn the floating button off and on, and choose “Entire screen” to read any app.
about.tipBattery: The button does nothing in the background: some phones restrict background apps — allow this app to run unrestricted in battery settings.
about.permAccessibilityWhy: Optional, and only if you turn it on in Android settings: scrolls the page in “Speak with auto-scroll” and presses your pinned Next button in “Speak with pagination”. It reads, stores and sends nothing.
about.ttsBody: Speech uses your phone's own text-to-speech engine (Google Speech Services when installed). Offline voices run on the device; voices marked “Needs internet” are processed by the engine provider. No API keys or accounts are involved.
about.tipVoice: No sound or a wrong accent: install the voice for that language in Settings → Speech & voice → Install voice data.
about.permInternetWhy: Used only by “Speak with translation”, to reach the Google Gemini API after you opt in. No other feature uses the network.

reading.autoScrollHint: After a section is read, scroll to the next part
reading.disclosure: An overlay can't scroll other apps. Android only allows it through an accessibility service that you turn on yourself: Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → “Akshar auto-scroll”. It is used only to scroll the page being read aloud; it does not read, store or send screen content. Without it, the app asks you to scroll and continues when you tap ▶.
reading.notAllApps: Some apps don't expose scrollable content; a swipe is tried instead, and reading ends when no new text appears.
reading.maxNoNewText: Stop after screens with nothing new
reading.manualFallbackHint: Without auto-scroll: you scroll, then tap ▶ to continue

pagination.intro: Reads one page, presses your pinned Next Page button once, checks that the page changed, then reads the next page.
pagination.howTo: 1. Turn on the floating button. 2. Tap “Locate Next Page Button”. 3. Open your document app, drag the crosshair onto its Next button and tap Save.
pagination.exactClick: Exact button found — it is pressed directly.
pagination.pointClick: Pressed by tapping the pinned point.
pagination.problem_rotated: The screen was rotated since pinning. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_resized: The screen size or navigation bar changed since pinning. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_density_changed: Display size changed since pinning. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_out_of_bounds: The pinned point is off screen. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_not_identifiable: This button can’t be tracked as it moves. Pin it again with “Fixed position”.
pagination.clearConfirm: Speak with pagination will ask you to pin it again.
pagination.needsOverlay: Turn on the floating button first; the crosshair appears over your document app.
pagination.pickerShown: The crosshair is on screen. Switch to your document app, drag it onto the Next button and tap Save.
pagination.modes: “Fixed position” suits toolbars and bottom bars that stay put while the document scrolls. “Moves with page” finds the button again by its accessibility label before each press — only possible when the app exposes one. A pin never follows unpredictable layout changes; if the screen changes, the app stops and asks you to reposition instead of pressing the wrong spot.
pagination.verifyTimeout: Give up if the page doesn’t change after
pagination.permissionWhy: Pressing a button in another app needs Akshar’s accessibility service (Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Akshar page turner). It is used only to press the button you pinned and to scroll in auto-scroll mode.
pagination.controls: While reading: tap the bubble to pause or resume. The controller has Pause, Restart page, Next page now (Retry once / Skip page when stuck), Reposition and Stop. A failed page turn is never retried automatically.

translate.summaryNoKey: On · → {{target}} · add a Gemini key (General tab)
translate.intro: When Apply translation is on, the text recognised on your phone is translated with Google Gemini before it is copied or read aloud.
translate.privacy: When translation is on, the text recognised on screen (never the screenshot) and your instructions are sent to the Google Gemini API with your own key, under Google’s terms.
translate.voiceMissing: No {{language}} voice is installed, so the translation can’t be spoken. Install it under Speech & voice.
translate.applyHint: Copy and every read-aloud mode use the translation (of the refined text, if Refine text is on). Sends the extracted text to Google Gemini.
translate.needsKey: Translation needs a Gemini API key. Add it in Settings → General → Gemini AI.

refine.applyHint: Repairs OCR damage — broken or cut-off words, stray symbols — before the text is copied, translated or read aloud. Sends the extracted text to Google Gemini.
refine.summaryReady: On · runs before copy, translation and speech
refine.summaryNoKey: On · add a Gemini key (General tab)
refine.needsKey: Refinement needs a Gemini API key. Add it in Settings → General → Gemini AI (it also sets the model and thinking level).
refine.order: Order: scan → refine → translate (if on) → copy or speak.
refine.footer: Uses your own Gemini key. Only the recognised text is sent — never the screenshot.

audioShare.applyHint: Lets the Akshar Listen extension on your computer play Akshar’s voice — or all phone audio. Works on the same Wi-Fi; nothing goes through the internet.
audioShare.requestBody: Allow only if your computer shows {{fingerprint}}.
audioShare.idle: Connected — audio is sent while Akshar speaks and Chrome is playing
audioShare.paused: Chrome is paused — Akshar keeps speaking here
audioShare.error_no_wifi: Connect the phone to Wi-Fi (the same network as your computer).
audioShare.error_port_failed: Could not start sharing on this network. Turn it off and on to retry.
audioShare.error_unsupported: Audio sharing isn’t available on this device.
audioShare.howTo: On the computer: load the Akshar Listen extension (public/crome-extension, see its README), open it, enter the address above and click Connect.
audioShare.privacy: Only what you choose is shared — never the microphone or calls. Every new computer must be allowed here, and the connection is encrypted.
audioShare.addressHint: Enter this address in the Akshar Listen extension and click Connect, then tap Allow here when the request appears.
audioShare.sourceHint_device: Everything apps play — YouTube, browser, music, games — plus Akshar’s voice. Not phone or app calls, and not apps that block capture (often paid video/music apps). Needs the floating button on and Android 10 or later.
audioShare.device_needs_permission: Android needs the Microphone permission for capturing app audio. Nothing is recorded from the microphone.
audioShare.device_needs_bubble: Turn on the floating button — capturing app audio uses its screen-capture permission.
audioShare.device_unsupported: Capturing app audio needs Android 10 or later. Only Akshar’s voice can be shared.
audioShare.device_failed: Android didn’t allow capturing app audio. Turn the floating button off and on, then try again.
audioShare.device_idle: All phone audio is shared while Chrome is playing.
audioShare.permissionDenied: Permission not given — open Android Settings → Apps → Akshar → Permissions to allow Microphone.

gemini.apiKeyHint: Create one in Google AI Studio. Restrict it to the Generative Language API. It is stored encrypted on this phone and never shown again.
gemini.keySaveFailed: The key couldn’t be stored securely on this phone.
gemini.keyTooShort: That doesn’t look like an API key.
gemini.modelsHint: Filled in when you tap Test connection.
gemini.projectHint: For your reference. Requests are always billed and counted in the project that owns the API key — create the key in project {{project}} and usage lands there. The API keeps no chat history.
gemini.projectInvalid: A project number has digits only.
gemini.removeKeyConfirm: Speak with translation stops working until you add a key again.
gemini.security: An API key used from an app can be extracted by someone with access to the phone. For a public release, use a backend proxy or Firebase App Check, and restrict the key to this app in Google Cloud.
gemini.test_api_disabled: The Generative Language API isn’t enabled for this key’s Google Cloud project.
gemini.test_bad_response: Gemini answered in an unexpected format.
gemini.test_invalid_key: The key was rejected. Check that you pasted it correctly and that it isn’t restricted to other APIs.
gemini.test_model_not_found: This model isn’t available for your key. Pick one from the list below, or use gemini-flash-latest.
gemini.test_ok: Connected — Gemini translated a test phrase.
gemini.test_quota: Quota or rate limit reached for this key.
gemini.test_server: Gemini had a problem. Try again later.
gemini.thinkingHint: Low is quick and efficient — best for translation. Models without thinking levels ignore this.
gemini.summaryNoKey: No API key · used by Refine text and Translation
gemini.intro: One Google Gemini API key, model and thinking level for every AI feature in Akshar: Refine text and Translation (OCR tab), and any future ones. The key is stored encrypted on this phone.

files.title: File Management
files.intro: Store files in your own Google Drive and share them with a link — straight from your phone.
files.driveSubtitle: Where File Share stores your files
files.connectBody: Sign in with Google and the files you upload are saved in your own Google Drive, in a folder called {{folder}}.
files.point1: Akshar can only see files it uploads — not the rest of your Drive.
files.point2: Your files stay yours, even if you disconnect later.
files.point3: You can remove access at any time, here or in your Google account.
files.savedIn: Your uploads are saved in the {{folder}} folder of this Google Drive.
files.disconnectBody: Files you already uploaded stay in your Drive. Akshar loses access until you connect again.
files.connectFail_play_services: Google Play services is missing or out of date on this phone.
files.connectFail_setup_required: Google sign-in isn’t set up for this build of Akshar yet. The app must be registered in Google Cloud (package name and signing SHA-1, with the Drive API enabled).
files.connectFail_failed: Couldn’t sign in to Google. Try again.
files.shareSubtitle: Upload, organise and share files with a link
files.needsDrive: Connect Google Drive above to start uploading and sharing files.
files.descriptionPlaceholder: Description for the next upload (optional) — shows in Google Drive
files.emptyBody: Upload a file or create a folder to get started.
files.deleteBody: It moves to your Google Drive trash, where you can restore it for 30 days.
files.error_not_connected: Your Google Drive connection ended. Connect again above.
files.error_network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
files.error_permission: Akshar doesn’t have permission for Google Drive files on this account. Tap “Allow Drive access” and tick the Drive checkbox on Google’s screen.
files.error_not_found: That item no longer exists in your Drive. Refresh to update the list.
files.error_quota: Google Drive is out of storage or is limiting requests. Try again later.
files.error_unknown: Something went wrong with Google Drive. Try again.
files.privacy: Files go straight from your phone to your Google Drive — never through an Akshar server.
files.usingShared: Using the shared Google Drive set in Settings → File Management. Connect your own Google account to use your own Drive instead.
files.sharedHint: No shared Drive is set up. Connect your Google account, or add a shared Drive in Settings → File Management.
files.error_shared_auth: The shared Drive’s client or refresh token was rejected. Update them in Settings → File Management.
files.error_api_disabled: The Google Drive API is turned off for this app’s Google Cloud project. Enable “Google Drive API” in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Library) for the project that holds the Android sign-in client, wait a minute, then tap Try again.
files.noPreview: No preview for this type of file. Open it in Google Drive to view it.
files.pdfFailed_too_large: This PDF is over 100 MB, so only its first page is shown. Open it in Google Drive to read it all.
files.pdfFailed_preview_failed: This PDF couldn’t be opened here, so only its first page is shown. Open it in Google Drive to read it all.
files.pdfFailed_unsupported: PDF pages need Android. Only the first page is shown.

driveCreds.intro: File Share uses this Google Drive when no personal Google account is connected — the same values as the share-chat server (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN, GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID).
driveCreds.secretSaved: Current value …{{hint}}. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to override.
driveCreds.saved: Saved. These values now override the .env defaults.
driveCreds.saveFailed: Not saved — check that every value is filled in and in the right format (client ID ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com).
driveCreds.testOk: Connected — the folder is reachable ({{count}} items).
driveCreds.removeBody: Akshar forgets saved values and stops using the default configuration. Files already in the Drive stay there.
driveCreds.security: Stored encrypted on this phone (Android Keystore). The secret and refresh token are never shown again or sent anywhere except Google. Anyone with this Drive’s refresh token can access its files — keep it private and rotate it if it leaks.
driveCreds.usingDefault: Using the default configuration from .env. Type new values and Save to override them; “Use default configuration” brings the .env values back.
driveCreds.restored: Back to this build’s default configuration.

life.title: Manage Life
life.metricHelp: Targets met = periods where the target was reached. Last 7 days = periods that ended in the past week that met their target. Streak = consecutive met periods of one task.
life.pendingHint: These targets ended without being met. Tell us why to keep your history complete.
life.trendHint: Share of targets met among periods that ended each day.
life.emptyBody: Create a project, add measurable tasks, then log progress each day.
life.name: Name
life.error_quantity_invalid: Enter a target greater than zero.
life.error_interval_invalid: Enter a number of days between 1 and 365.
life.error_dates_invalid: The end date must be on or after the start date.
life.error_duplicate: That entry was just saved — it wasn’t added twice.
life.error_day_out_of_range: Pick a day within the task’s dates, not in the future.
life.error_target_met: This target was met — no reason needed.
life.error_already_reviewed: A reason was already given for this period.
life.error_note_required: Please explain “Other” in a few words.
life.noTasks: No tasks yet. Add a measurable task to track progress.
life.deleteProjectBody: This permanently deletes the project, its {{tasks}} tasks and {{reports}} progress reports and reasons. This can’t be undone. Archive it instead to keep the history.
life.deleteTaskBody: This permanently deletes the task and its {{reports}} progress reports and reasons. This can’t be undone. Archive it instead to keep the history.
life.targetChangeNote: Target changes start from the next period ({{date}}); past periods keep their original target.
life.helpIntro: Fill in what you know — suggestions are worked out on your phone.
life.helpBaseline: What I manage now, per period
life.helpNone: Add a goal and deadline, your current baseline, or available time to get suggestions.
life.helpBasis_time: About 80% of {{minutesPerDay}} free minutes a day
life.helpBasis_history_ok: You met this target in {{hitRate}}% of the last {{periods}} periods — keep it
life.helpBasis_history_lower: Met in only {{hitRate}}% of {{periods}} periods (average {{average}}); a little above your average
life.reviewNoReports: No progress was logged for this period.
life.reviewSupport: Missing a target happens. Knowing why helps you set better targets.
life.reason_low_energy: Low energy or not enough rest
life.dayEmpty: No targets scheduled on this day.
life.reasonsEmpty: No missed-target reasons in this period.
life.heatmapHint: Darker = more targets met that day.
life.quantitiesHint: Each task in its own unit — units are never added together.
life.aiPrivacy: Sends a summary of your Manage Life targets, progress, notes and reasons to Google Gemini with your own key (Settings → General → Gemini AI). Nothing else from the app is sent.
life.aiStale: Your data changed since these were generated.
life.aiNotEnough: Not enough history yet for useful AI advice — {{count}} of {{needed}} completed target periods. Here are a few observations from your data so far.
life.aiCooldown: Please wait a few seconds before asking again.
life.aiReason_no_key: Add a Gemini API key in Settings → General → Gemini AI.
life.aiReason_timeout: Gemini took too long. Try again.
life.aiReason_quota: Gemini rate limit or quota reached. Try again later.
life.aiReason_invalid_key: The Gemini API key was rejected.
life.aiReason_api_disabled: The Gemini API isn’t enabled for this key.
life.aiReason_model_not_found: The Gemini model isn’t available — pick another in Settings → General → Gemini AI.
life.aiReason_bad_response: Gemini’s answer wasn’t in the expected format.
life.local_realism: “{{task}}”: target met in {{met}} of the last {{total}} periods ({{pct}}%). Consider a smaller target you can hit most days.
life.local_blocker: Most common reason for missed targets: {{reason}} ({{count}} times recently).
life.local_pending: {{count}} ended targets still need a reason.
life.local_positive: “{{task}}”: {{streak}} targets met in a row — keep it up.
life.local_start: Create a project and add a measurable task to start getting insights.
life.widgetNote: Tip: add the “Manage Life” widget to your home screen to see progress and log with one tap.
life.local_early: Keep logging — observations appear once a few target periods have ended.
life.widget_setup: Open Akshar → Manage Life to add tasks.
life.taskCalendarHint: Each day is shaded by how much of its target period was done. Weekly and every-N-days targets shade the whole period.
life.projectCalendarHint: Average completion across the task targets scheduled that day. Each task counts against its own target (capped at 100%); units are never added.
life.taskChartHint: Target and actual for each period, in the task's own unit. Tap a period for its numbers.
life.projectChartHint: Each task's line shows the share of its planned total reported so far, so tasks with different units can be compared.
life.chartAvgExplain: Average actual: the mean of the task lines (each capped at 100%) for tasks that have started. Average target: the mean share each task should have reached by that date if its target had been met every period; a period's target is spread evenly across its days, and paused periods plan nothing.
life.chartAllHidden: All lines are hidden. Tap a name above to show it.
life.chartEmptyTask: No target periods yet. Progress appears here once the task's first period starts.
life.chartEmptyProject: No task has a planned target within the project dates yet.
life.overallHint: {{done}} of {{total}} {{unit}} planned for the whole schedule
life.projectOverallHint: Average across tasks, each measured against its own planned total.

utility.title: Utility
utility.intro: Handy tools that work on this phone. Nothing starts — camera, sensors or sound — until you open a tool and start it.
utility.toolDesc_scanner: Read QR codes and product barcodes; copy, call, email or open links safely.
utility.toolDesc_documents: Scan pages with edge detection and export a PDF or images.
utility.toolDesc_compass: Magnetic heading with a live dial.
utility.toolDesc_measure: Length, height and distance with the camera (ARCore), or with angles and one length you know.
utility.toolDesc_water: A low tone and gentle vibration to help clear water from the speaker.
utility.noSensor: No compass sensor on this phone
utility.arInstallShort: Installs Google Play Services for AR on first use
utility.noSensorBody: This phone has no magnetometer, so it can’t show a heading.
utility.calibrateBody: Move the phone in a figure-8 a few times, away from metal and magnets.
utility.compassDisclaimer: Shows magnetic north. Phone cases with magnets, nearby metal and electronics can make readings wrong — don’t rely on it for navigation where safety matters.
utility.scannerIntro: Point the camera at a QR code or a barcode (EAN, UPC, Code 128, Code 39, PDF417, Data Matrix and more). Links are never opened automatically.
utility.scannerPermission: The camera is used only while the scanner is open. Pictures are not saved.
utility.scanAim: Point the camera at a QR code or barcode
utility.cameraProblem_denied: Allow camera access to scan codes.
utility.cameraProblem_blocked: Camera access was turned off for Akshar. Allow it in Android settings to scan.
utility.cameraProblem_camera_failed: Another app may be using the camera. Close it and try again.
utility.cameraProblem_unavailable: The scanner isn’t available on this device.
utility.linkWarn_insecure: This link isn’t secure (http). Only open it if you trust where the code came from.
utility.linkWarn_ip: This link goes to a raw IP address, which is unusual for real websites.
utility.linkWarn_punycode: This address uses look-alike characters and may imitate another site.
utility.linkWarn_credentials: This link hides a sign-in name before the address — a common phishing trick.
utility.cannotOpen: No app on this phone can open that.
utility.clearHistoryBody: All saved scans will be deleted from this phone.
utility.docsIntro: Scan paper documents: edges are found automatically, you can drag the corners, and pages are straightened. Add filters, then reorder, rotate or retake pages here and export a PDF or images.
utility.docsPrivacy: Scans stay on this phone. Google’s on-device scanner is used; nothing is uploaded.
utility.docsUnavailable: This phone doesn’t have Google Play services, which the document scanner needs.
utility.scanFailed: The scanner couldn’t start. Make sure Google Play services is up to date.
utility.pagesHint: Tap a page to view it.
utility.noPages: No pages — add some to export.
utility.exportHint: You choose where files are saved. Images go into a folder you pick, one file per page.
utility.shareFailed: No app can receive the PDF.
utility.docActionFailed: That didn’t work — there may not be enough storage space. Try again.
utility.deleteDocBody: “{{name}}” and its pages will be deleted from this phone.
utility.waterSafety: This may help shake some water out of the speaker grille, but it can’t guarantee it or repair water damage. Don’t charge a wet phone. Follow the manufacturer’s guidance, and get it repaired if problems continue.
utility.waterHow: Turn the phone so the speaker faces down, set the media volume to a comfortable level, then tap Start. Repeat once if needed.
utility.waterVolume: Start around half volume and turn it up only as far as comfortable — never past a level that hurts your ears.
utility.waterEnded_interrupted: Stopped — another app needed the audio.
utility.waterEnded_denied: Another app is using audio (maybe a call). Try again when it’s finished.
utility.waterDisclaimer: Plays only while this screen is open.
utility.measureIntro: Measure with the camera: aim the centre ring at a surface and add points. ARCore tracks the room, so move the phone slowly first.
utility.measureAccuracy: Results are estimates — typically within a few centimetres in good light on textured surfaces, worse on shiny, dark or plain surfaces. Not for precise work.
utility.measureHint_height: Vertical difference between two points (e.g. floor to the top of a table).
utility.measureHint_distance: From the phone to the surface under the centre ring.
utility.source_point: Measured on feature points — less reliable.
utility.arUnsupportedBody: This phone isn’t certified for ARCore, which AR Measure needs for real-world distances. The app won’t guess measurements from the camera picture.
utility.arInstallNote: The first time, Android will ask to install Google Play Services for AR.
utility.arUnknown: Checking whether this phone supports ARCore…
utility.measureProblem_blocked: Camera access was turned off for Akshar. Allow it in Android settings to measure.
utility.measureProblem_ar_install_declined: AR Measure needs Google Play Services for AR. Start again to install it.
utility.measureProblem_ar_failed: The AR camera couldn’t start. Close other camera apps and try again.
utility.ar_initializing: Move your phone slowly to find surfaces
utility.ar_fewFeatures: Aim at a surface with some texture
utility.ar_lostPoints: Points lost — aim back at them or reset
utility.ar_doneHint: Save the result, or reset to measure again
utility.ar_aimSurface: Aim the centre ring at a surface
utility.ar_captureHint: Tap Capture to keep this distance
utility.ar_firstPoint: Aim at the start and tap Add point
utility.ar_secondPoint: Aim at the end and tap Add point
utility.ar_secondPointHeight: Aim at the top (or bottom) and tap Add point
utility.toolDesc_recorder: Screenshots, screen and voice recording from a floating button, with long recordings saved in parts.
utility.toolDesc_stopwatch: Run several named stopwatches at once, each with laps. They keep counting when you leave the app.
utility.toolDesc_timer: Several named timers at once, each with its own ringtone and alert — even with the app closed.
utility.toolDesc_level: Check if a surface or edge is level, with calibration.
utility.toolDesc_converter: Length, area, weight, volume, temperature, speed and data.
utility.arUnsupportedAngleOk: No ARCore here — angle measuring works
utility.lapsEmpty: Laps appear here. Tap Lap while the stopwatch runs.
utility.timerHint: Timers keep running if you leave or close the app. Each one rings on its own with the alert you chose; finishing one never stops the others.
utility.timerInexact: Exact alarms are off for this app, so Android may deliver the alert a little late while the phone is idle.
utility.timerNoNotifications: Notifications are off for Akshar, so the alert can only show while the app is open.
utility.levelNoSensorBody: This phone has no accelerometer or gravity sensor, so the level can't work.
utility.levelHint_flat: Lying flat: the bubble moves to the higher side.
utility.levelHint_edge: Standing on an edge: the line shows the angle off level or plumb.
utility.levelFlatA11y: Left to right {{x}}, front to back {{y}}
utility.calibrateHint: Put the phone on a surface you know is level (or against a true edge) and tap Calibrate. Flat and edge positions are calibrated separately.
utility.angleIntro: Enter one length you know, then aim the camera's crosshair at each point. The phone's tilt angles and trigonometry give the result.
utility.angleAccuracy: Hold the phone steady and aim through the camera. Accuracy depends on the length you enter and on the angles: aiming close to the horizon makes floor distances less accurate.
utility.trig_heightFromDeviceHeight: Height — I know my phone's height
utility.trig_distanceFromDeviceHeight: Distance — I know my phone's height
utility.trig_floorLength: Floor length — I know my phone's height
utility.trigDesc_heightFromDistance: Enter how far the object is from you. Aim at its base, then its top.
utility.trigDesc_heightFromDeviceHeight: Enter how high the phone is above the floor. Aim at the object's base on the floor, then its top.
utility.trigDesc_distanceFromDeviceHeight: Enter how high the phone is above the floor. Aim at a point on the floor.
utility.trigDesc_floorLength: Enter how high the phone is above the floor. Aim at one end of the length on the floor, then the other.
utility.known_distance: Horizontal distance from your phone to the object ({{unit}})
utility.known_deviceHeight: Height of your phone's camera above the floor ({{unit}})
utility.knownHint_distance: Measure it along the ground, from where you stand to the object's base.
utility.knownHint_deviceHeight: Hold the phone at this height for every point (e.g. at eye level, measured once).
utility.trigFormula_heightFromDistance: Height = distance × (tan top angle − tan base angle)
utility.trigFormula_heightFromDeviceHeight: Distance = phone height ÷ tan(angle down to the base); Height = distance × (tan top angle − tan base angle)
utility.trigFormula_distanceFromDeviceHeight: Distance = phone height ÷ tan(angle down to the point)
utility.trigFormula_floorLength: Each distance = phone height ÷ tan(angle down); Length = √(d1² + d2² − 2·d1·d2·cos turn), where the turn is how far you rotated between the two points
utility.sight_base: aim the crosshair at the base of the object and tap Capture angle
utility.sight_top: aim at the top of the object and tap Capture angle
utility.sight_floorPoint: aim at the point on the floor and tap Capture angle
utility.sight_floorStart: aim at one end on the floor and tap Capture angle
utility.sight_floorEnd: keep the phone at the same height, aim at the other end and tap Capture angle
utility.trigUncertainty: About ± {{value}} if each angle is off by half a degree
utility.trigLowAngle: You aimed close to the horizon, so small errors in the angle change the distance a lot. Stand closer or hold the phone higher.
utility.trigInLine: This phone has no rotation sensor, so the two ends are assumed to be in a straight line away from you.
utility.angleProblem_known_invalid: Enter the known length first (more than 0).
utility.angleProblem_angles_missing: Not every point was captured. Try again.
utility.angleProblem_top_below_base: The top was aimed below the base. Aim at the base first, then the top.
utility.angleProblem_not_below_horizon: Floor points must be below eye level: aim down at the floor.
utility.angleProblem_too_steep: An angle was too close to straight up or down to measure. Step back and try again.
utility.angleProblem_denied: Camera access is needed to aim.
utility.angleProblem_blocked: Camera access is off for Akshar. Turn it on in Settings.
utility.angleProblem_no_sensor: This phone has no tilt sensor, so angles can't be measured.
utility.angleProblem_camera_failed: The camera couldn't start. Close other camera apps and try again.
utility.angleProblem_failed: Angle measuring couldn't start. Try again.
utility.stopwatchEmptyBody: Add one for each thing you want to time. They all run independently.
utility.limitReached: You can have up to {{count}}. Delete one to add another.

3. Choose “{{name}}” and confirm the code on both screens.

recorder.unsupported: The screen recorder is available on Android only.
recorder.idleHint: Turn on the recording button, then tap it over any app. Long-press it to choose what a tap does.
recorder.enableButtonHint: A separate button from the OCR button. Drag to move; long-press to change mode.
recorder.hideWhileRecording: Hide the button? The recording keeps going — stop it from the notification or the controls.
recorder.toggleFailed: Couldn’t change the recording button. Try again.
recorder.overlayBody: The recording button floats over other apps. Allow “Display over other apps” for Akshar, then come back.
recorder.endCaptureHint: Screen capture stays allowed between captures. End it now; Android will ask again next time.
recorder.modeDesc_voice: Record system audio (or the microphone, per Audio settings).
recorder.privacy: Everything stays on this phone: nothing is uploaded. Android shows its capture indicator and an ongoing notification while recording. Apps that block capture (secure screens, protected audio) can’t be recorded.
recorder.interruptedBody_one: {{count}} recording was cut off. Its finished parts were kept.
recorder.interruptedBody_other: {{count}} recordings were cut off. Their finished parts were kept.
recorder.settingsHint: Save folders, quality, parts and the button
recorder.libraryEmptyHint: Screenshots and recordings from the recording button appear here.
recorder.mergeQueued: Merging in the background — this entry updates when it’s done.
recorder.renameFailed: Couldn’t rename. Use a name without / \ : * ? " < > |.
recorder.deleteBody: The file and any kept parts are deleted from the device. This can’t be undone.
recorder.deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete — it may still be in use.
recorder.openFailed: No app on this phone can open it.
recorder.partsKept_one: {{count}} part is kept and can be played or merged again.
recorder.partsKept_other: {{count}} parts are kept and can be played or merged again.
recorder.partsDeleted: The parts were deleted after the merged file was verified.
recorder.error_generic: Something went wrong with the recorder.
recorder.error_storage_low: Storage is almost full. The recording was stopped and everything up to then was kept.
recorder.error_overlay_permission: Allow “Display over other apps” to show the recording button.
recorder.error_consent_denied: Screen capture wasn’t allowed, so nothing was captured.
recorder.error_mic_permission: Microphone access is needed to record audio (Android also requires it for system audio).
recorder.error_projection: Screen capture couldn’t start. Try again.
recorder.error_foreground: Android didn’t let the recorder start in the background. Open the app and try again.
recorder.error_dir_access: A save folder is no longer accessible. Choose it again under Recording settings → Save folders.
recorder.error_audio_unavailable: No audio source could start, so nothing was recorded.
recorder.error_storage: Couldn’t create the recording file. Check the save folder and free space.
recorder.error_encoder: This phone’s video encoder couldn’t start with these settings. Try a lower quality.
recorder.error_video_encoder: The video encoder stopped. The recording was saved up to that point.
recorder.error_audio_encoder: Audio capture stopped. The recording was saved up to that point.
recorder.error_muxer: Writing the file failed. The recording was saved up to that point.
recorder.error_capture_revoked: Screen capture ended (sharing stopped, screen locked or another app started capturing). The recording was saved up to then.
recorder.error_process_killed: The app was closed by Android during this recording. Finished parts were kept — merge them to save the recording.
recorder.error_merge_failed: Merging failed. The parts were kept — try again.
recorder.error_no_segments: There are no saved parts left to merge.
recorder.error_no_tracks: The parts contain no playable media.
recorder.error_verify_failed: The merged file didn’t verify, so it was removed. The parts were kept — try again.
recorder.error_incompatible: The parts use different formats and can’t be joined.
recorder.error_busy: Wait for the current recording to finish.
recorder.settingsSaveFailed: Couldn’t save that setting. Try again.
recorder.buttonFooter: The button’s position is kept between restarts. Its long-press menu sets what a tap does.
recorder.longPressMenuHint: Long-press the button to choose Screenshot, Screen, Voice or Screen + Voice.
recorder.showControlsHint: Elapsed time, part number, Pause and Stop next to the button while recording.
recorder.autoSaveScreenshotHint: Off: a screenshot is saved only when you tap Save (or save from the editor).
recorder.keepCaptureHint: Android asks once and the capture indicator stays on until you end it. Off: Android asks before every capture.
recorder.summaryStorage: Default folders unless you choose others
recorder.storageFooter: Folders are picked with Android’s file picker; the app can write only there and needs no storage permission. Parts are written straight to storage, never kept in memory.
recorder.dirHint_merged: Same as screen or voice recordings
recorder.dirTestFailed: Couldn’t write there. Choose another folder.
recorder.dirPickFailed: Couldn’t use that folder. Choose another one.
recorder.videoFooter: Fitted to this phone’s screen and encoder — an unsupported size, frame rate or bitrate is lowered automatically. The recording keeps the orientation it started in.
recorder.videoApplied: On this phone: {{width}}×{{height}}, {{fps}} fps, {{mbps}} Mbps — about {{perHour}} per hour.
recorder.audioFooter: System audio is what apps play (media, games). Android never captures calls, and apps can opt out — often music and video apps with protected content — so their sound won’t be recorded.
recorder.systemAudioOld: System audio needs Android 10 or later. On this phone only the microphone can be recorded.
recorder.audioSourceDesc_system: Sound from apps that allow capture. Nothing from the microphone.
recorder.audioSourceDesc_mic: Your voice and surroundings through the microphone.
recorder.segmentsFooter: Recording continues without a gap between parts: a new part starts on the next key frame (within about a second). After Stop the parts are joined without re-encoding. If the app is closed by Android, finished parts survive and can be merged from Recordings.
recorder.segmentEnabledHint: Recommended for recordings over a few minutes.
recorder.autoMergeHint: Joins the parts into one file in the background.
recorder.keepSegmentsHint: Off: parts are deleted only after the merged file is verified.

recorder.storageWarningHint: Recording won’t start below this, and stops safely (keeping everything so far) if space runs out. Recordings are never deleted to make room.

recorder.fileNamesHint: Date and time, e.g. Screenshot_2026-10-30_10-30-15.png, ScreenRecording_…_Final.mp4. Never overwritten.

browser.title: Browser
browser.lateInjection: This phone's WebView can't run the recorder before the page starts, so the very first requests of each page may be missed.
browser.blockedScheme: This link type can't be opened in the inspector browser.

calls.title: Captured Network Calls
calls.searchPlaceholder: Search URL, endpoint, method or status
calls.rowHint: Opens the request and response. Long press to select.
calls.emptyHint: Turn on Network Capture, open an allowed site in the browser and use it normally.
calls.exportFailed: The export couldn't be created. Please try again.
calls.deleteBody: Its recorded request and response are removed from this phone.
calls.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.

detail.title: Request
detail.requestHeadersHint: Includes the headers the browser adds itself: cookies come from the browser's cookie store; User-Agent, Referer, Origin, Accept-Language and sec-* are filled in as the browser sends them.
detail.responseHeadersHint: Cross-origin responses only expose the headers the server allows.
detail.binaryTooLarge: Binary content ({{size}}) over the size limit; not stored.
detail.truncated: Truncated at the body size limit — the original was {{size}}.
detail.truncatedUnknown: Truncated at the body size limit.
detail.displayTrimmed: Showing the first {{shown}}k characters. Copy to get it all.
detail.redactionNote: Copies and the cURL below have sensitive values redacted. Change this in Network Inspector → Privacy & limits.
detail.copyFailed: Couldn't copy (it may be too large for the clipboard).

cancel.pageLeft: Page was left before the response arrived
cancel.browserClosed: Browser was closed before the response arrived
cancel.captureOff: Capture was turned off before the response arrived

alarms.modeDesc_both: Rings with your ringtone and vibrates.
alarms.modeDesc_sound: Rings with your ringtone, no vibration.
alarms.modeDesc_silent: Just a notification, no sound or vibration.
alarms.modeDesc_priority: Full volume, sound and vibration, alarm-clock scheduling and a lock-screen alarm screen. Still follows your Do Not Disturb settings for alarms.
alarms.fullScreenOff: Android isn't allowing Akshar to show alarms on the lock screen, so high-priority alerts appear as a notification.
alarms.noVibrator: This phone can't vibrate, so only the sound or notification will alert you.
alarms.volumeHint: Relative to your phone's alarm volume, which Akshar never changes.
alarms.dndNote: Alerts play on the alarm channel. Do Not Disturb, notification settings and battery restrictions you set on the phone still apply.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.empty_upcoming: Nothing coming up. Tap New reminder to add one.
reminders.empty_off: Reminders you switch off appear here.
reminders.notificationsOff: Notifications are off for Akshar, so reminders can't alert you.
reminders.inexact: Exact alarms are off for Akshar, so Android may deliver reminders a few minutes late while the phone is idle.
reminders.alarm_unavailable: Alarms aren't available on this device.
reminders.alarm_failed: Reminders couldn't be scheduled. Open the app again to retry.
reminders.error_in_past: That time has already passed. Choose a later time or a repeat.
reminders.error_limit: You've reached the reminder limit. Delete some old ones first.

photoWidget.title: Photo Widgets
photoWidget.intro: Put your photos on the home screen. Each photo widget can be placed as many times as you like and resized from the home screen.
photoWidget.emptyBody: Choose a photo to create your first one.
photoWidget.error_import: Couldn't read that photo. Try another one.
photoWidget.placed_zero: Not on the home screen yet
photoWidget.howTo: You can also long-press the home screen → Widgets → Akshar → Photo, then pick one of these photos.
photoWidget.modeHint_fit: The whole photo is shown; empty space may appear at the sides.
photoWidget.modeHint_fill: The photo covers the whole widget, centred; edges may be cut off.
photoWidget.modeHint_crop: You choose which part shows: drag the photo in the preview and zoom.
photoWidget.shapeAutoHint: Fills whatever size you give the widget on the home screen
photoWidget.dragToCrop: drag the photo to choose what shows
photoWidget.name: Name
photoWidget.saved: Saved. Widgets showing this photo were updated.
photoWidget.pinAsked: Confirm on the home screen to place the widget.
photoWidget.pinManual: Your launcher can't add widgets from apps: long-press the home screen → Widgets → Akshar → Photo.
photoWidget.removeBody_one: {{count}} widget on your home screen will ask for a new photo.
photoWidget.removeBody_other: {{count}} widgets on your home screen will ask for a new photo.
photoWidget.notFound: This photo widget no longer exists.
photoWidget.resizeOnHome: On the home screen, long-press the widget and drag its handles to resize it.

connect.title: Connect to a device
connect.hint: Enter the 8-digit ID shown in Featured App on the computer or phone you want to control.
connect.waitingHint: Check that the same code is shown on the other screen:
connect.nearbyEmpty: No devices found on this Wi-Fi yet. Open Featured App on the computer, or enter its ID above.
connect.savedEmpty: Devices you connect to appear here.
connect.removeHint: Also forgets its security key. Use this if the device was reinstalled.
connect.savedPasswordRemoved: The saved password no longer works and was removed. Enter the new one.

errors.badTarget: That is not a device ID or an address. A device ID has 8 digits.
errors.self: That is this phone's own ID.
errors.noRoute: That device is not on this network and no remote server is set.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the device. Check that Featured App is open on it and that remote access is on.
errors.rejected: The person at the other device declined.
errors.rate-limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.blocked: The other device has blocked this phone.
errors.busy: The other device is already in a remote session.
errors.not-accepting: The other device does not accept remote connections.
errors.unattended-off: Unattended access is off there. Connect without a password to ask the person at the device.
errors.timeout: Nobody answered the request in time.
errors.no-session: The session is over and cannot be resumed.
errors.screen-permission: The other device has not allowed screen sharing.
errors.identity: The device could not prove it is who it claims to be.
errors.key-changed: This device's security key changed since your last connection. If it was not reinstalled, someone may be impersonating it. Remove it from Saved devices to trust the new key.
errors.protocol: That device runs an incompatible version of the app. Update both.

viewer.touchModeHint: Touch: tap where you want to click. Trackpad: drag to move the cursor, tap to click.
viewer.endedLost: The connection was lost and could not be restored.
viewer.endedOther: The other device ended the session.
viewer.noticeTimer: The owner changed the session time.
viewer.noticeWarning: The session ends in {{minutes}} min. Ask the owner to extend it.
viewer.noticeView: The owner switched this session to view only.
viewer.help: Tap = click · Hold = right click · Drag = select · Two fingers = scroll · Pinch = zoom
viewer.helpPhone: Tap = tap · Hold = long press · Drag = swipe · Pinch = zoom

phone.idHint: Others connect to this phone with this ID.
phone.allow: Allow remote access to this phone
phone.allowHint: While the app is open, a computer or phone can ask to see and control this phone. You accept every request (unless you set an unattended password).
phone.iosUnsupported: iPhones cannot be controlled remotely — iOS does not allow it. You can still control other devices from here.
phone.listenError: Could not listen on the network: {{error}}
phone.controlOn: On — the other device can tap and type
phone.controlOff: Off — others can only view. Turn on "Akshar Remote Access" in Accessibility.
phone.sessionReconnecting: Connection dropped — waiting for {{name}} to come back…

request.title: Remote access request
request.firstTime: This device has never connected before. Only accept if you know who it is.
request.codeHint: Make sure the other screen shows the same code.
request.controlOff: Remote control is off on this phone, so the other device will only be able to view until you turn it on.

history.reconnectHint: Connects again, with the saved password if there is one

settings.viewOnlyHint: The other device shows your request as view only.
settings.keepAwake: Keep the screen on while connected
settings.defaultMinutesHint: Pre-selected when you accept a request; also the length of unattended sessions.
settings.unattendedHint: Connect with a password without anyone accepting on this phone. Android still asks once per session to allow screen sharing.

passwordProblem.common: That password is too easy to guess.
passwordProblem.weak: Use 12+ characters, or mix upper case, lower case, digits and symbols.

settings.relayHint: Connects devices on different networks. Leave empty to use the built-in server ({{server}}). wss://… or host:port.
settings.turnHint: For video between networks when there is no direct path, e.g. turn:turn.example.com:3478.
settings.turnInvalid: Use stun:, turn: or turns: followed by the address.
settings.rememberPasswordsHint: After an unattended connection works, its password is kept encrypted on this phone (Android Keystore), so Reconnect does not ask again.
settings.forgetAllPasswordsConfirm: Remove every saved password from this phone?

liveCamera.title: Share Live Camera
liveCamera.intro: Turn this phone into a live webcam. Tap Start streaming to get a link; anyone who opens it in Chrome, Safari or any browser watches live — nothing to install. Works on Wi-Fi and mobile data.
liveCamera.permissionNeeded: Camera permission is needed to stream.
liveCamera.backgroundWarning: Background streaming could not start. Keep the app open while streaming.

share.title: Share
share.revoked: Link revoked — no one can watch. Tap New link to share again.

settings.title: Stream settings
settings.lockedWhileLive: Resolution, frame rate, audio and server are fixed while live. Stop to change them.

errors.no_server: Set the streaming server address in Stream settings first.
errors.server_unreachable: The streaming server is unreachable. Check the internet connection and the server address.
errors.server_error: The streaming server refused the request. Try again.
errors.server_full: The streaming server is full. Try again later.
errors.rate_limited: Too many streams from this connection. Wait a little and try again.
errors.password: A private stream needs a password of at least 4 characters.
errors.camera_failed: The camera could not be opened. Another app may be using it.
errors.no_camera: This phone has no camera available.
errors.mic_denied: Microphone permission is needed for audio. Turn audio off or allow it.
errors.stream_ended: The server ended this stream. Start again for a new link.

library.noLiked: No liked songs yet — tap ♥ on a song
library.permissionWhy: Allow access to music so the app can list the songs on this phone. You can also import files without it.
library.permissionBlocked: Music access is turned off for this app. Turn it on in Settings, or import files instead.

playlists.noSongs: No songs — add some from the song menu (⋯)

player.nothing: Nothing playing. Pick a song in the Library.

studio.headphones: Use headphones: the 3D effect is rendered for two ears (binaural), not for a phone speaker.

quality.hint0: Lighter 3D model (4 speakers, no pinna cues, smaller reverb): least battery.
quality.hint1: Full 3D with moderate reverb — the best everyday choice.
quality.hint2: Every cue and the largest reverb; uses a little more battery.

presets.overwrite: Save current sound into this preset
presets.restoreBody: Built-in presets go back to their original sound. Your own presets are kept.

stage.label: Virtual studio
stage.hint: Drag to move the sound around you
stage.liveHint: Showing where the engine is placing the sound right now. Drag to move it.
stage.idleHint: Play a song to see and hear the sound move. Drag to place it.

eq.title: Equalizer
eq.limiterHint: Keeps the output below clipping however much you boost.

system.title: Other apps
system.intro: Android does not let an app freely change other apps' sound. Below are the two routes Android allows; each depends on the other app, and some apps (or protected/DRM content) will not work. Calls and the microphone are never touched.
system.unavailable: System-wide audio is available on Android only.
system.effectsTitle: Effects on music apps (reliable, no 8D movement)
system.effectsBody: Players that announce their audio session (many music apps do; YouTube usually does not) get your equalizer, bass, virtual surround, reverb and loudness. Open the other app and start playing — it appears below when it announces itself.
system.noSessions: No app has announced an audio session yet.
system.captureBody: Records the sound other apps allow to be captured, runs it through the 8D engine and plays the result. Android always keeps playing the original too — switch on "Hear only the 8D sound" below to silence it. The processing adds a short delay (video may look slightly out of sync).

startErrors.unsupported: This phone cannot capture other apps' sound.
startErrors.permission: Microphone permission is needed by Android to capture app sound (the microphone itself is not recorded).

system.levels: In {{input}} dB · out {{output}} dB · delay ~{{latency}} ms
system.silent: No sound is arriving. The app playing may not allow capture (for example protected or DRM content), or nothing is playing.
system.flowing: Sound is being captured and processed.

errors.capture_unavailable: Android refused to capture app sound on this phone.
errors.capture_lost: Capturing stopped (the screen-capture permission ended or another app took over).
errors.output_failed: Could not play the processed sound.

system.hearOnlyHint: Silences the original app (media volume to 0, given back when you stop) and plays the 8D version on its own volume. While on, the volume keys change the 8D volume.
system.helperOff: One-time setup: in Accessibility settings, open "Installed apps" → "8D Audio volume helper" and turn it on. Android needs it to give the 8D sound its own volume; it reads no screen content.
system.hearRefused: Android did not allow the volume change. Make sure the 8D Audio volume helper is on.
system.btSharedVolume: Bluetooth headsets share one volume for all sound, so the original can't be silenced. Fix (one time): in Developer options, turn on "Disable absolute volume", then turn Bluetooth off and on. To unlock Developer options: Settings → About phone → Software information → tap "Build number" 7 times.
